claims.claim_text: If slow CRC errors appear on only one port at Rauta, it is probably not the unit itself but usually the patch lead. Swap the lead first and clear the counters, and if the errors come back, clean the connector and then try the SFP.
claims.symptom: slow but continuing CRC errors on a single port while the neighbouring port is clean
claims.check_step: Check whether only this port shows CRC errors or the neighbouring port as well
claims.action: Swap the patch lead and clear the counters
